issues.title: Changed render and main route prose still escape the closed guard

verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 4 closes the router docstrings and the changed workflow route-comment blocks with normalized exact-equality pins, but it still does not close all changed route-contract prose. In particular, `usage-alert.py` changes both the rendered operator guidance and `main()`'s route comment, while guard 1 covers only `_alert_route`'s docstring and dispatch.yml. Those two changed consumers remain protected solely by the explicitly finite lexical tripwire. Appending an unlisted capability assertion such as `ALERT_TOKEN has issue-creation privileges at ALERT_REPO` to either changed block still leaves the canonical pins unchanged and `claims_about_the_route(scanned) == []`. The prior round's major finding therefore remains materially unchanged, so progress is stagnant.
